_: How big and heavy the posted parcel is, worked out from what the kit contains (WW-123).
_why: Flipkart asks for it twice, in different units and on different tabs, and Meesho asks too. Guessing it per listing is how a listing goes out declaring 8cm when the box is 4 — and the courier weighs the real parcel at pickup and charges the difference back at settlement, which is WW-055. So it is computed from the inventory, once, in one place.
_units: Centimetres and grams. The inch values the Additional Description tab wants are derived, never stored — two copies of one measurement drift.
_volumetric: Couriers bill on whichever is greater, the real weight or L x B x H / 5000 kg. The panel shows both and says which one you would be charged on.

base._: Vansh, 2026-08-08: a normal 40-60 piece kit. The 250 g is MEASURED on a real parcel; the dimensions are the standard polybag these are packed in.

_maxGrams: Vansh's ceiling — he wants every parcel under 500 g, 490 to leave room. Over it, the panel warns; it does not silently shrink anything.

rules.name: net
rules._: A net does not fold flat, so the parcel gets taller — Vansh's figure. addGrams is an ESTIMATE and has not been weighed: he confirmed a net adds weight but had no number to hand. Weigh one and correct it here.

rules.name: pump
rules._: Vansh's figures, 2026-08-08: about 50 g, and the longer polybag.

_matching: whenAnyOf holds MATERIAL NAMES from materials.json, matched the same way a kit line is — so an old name in its `aka` list works too, and a renamed row keeps working as long as the rename happens in materials.json. Deliberately not a keyword like 'net', which would also catch a future 'Netted Curtain'.
_boxes: The polybag sizes to choose from, offered as a dropdown on the Inventory panel. The rules above pick one automatically; this is how a human overrules that for one kit. UNCONFIRMED — Vansh, 2026-08-08: 'I think I have given you the wrong dimensions for the height when the net and the pump goes in, we will check that later on.' Measure a real parcel of each kind and correct them here; the rules read the same numbers.
